d: Trying to eat healthier in 2026? Before you overhaul your diet, take a closer look at the foods you already consider healthy. In this video, I break down 7 foods and food choices I'm reconsidering, from bananas in smoothies and whole grain bread to canned soup, artificial food dyes, farm-raised salmon and yogurt. Some are personal preferences. Others raise questions about ingredients, processing and whether you're getting the benefits you expect.
